sloka: तुल्य शील वयो वृत्ताम् तुल्य अभिजन लक्षणाम् ।राघवो अर्हति वैदेहीम् तम् च इयम् असित ईक्षणा ॥५-१६-५॥
transliteration: tulya śīla vayo vṛttām tulya abhijana lakṣaṇām ।rāghavo arhati vaidehīm tam ca iyam asita īkṣaṇā ॥5-16-5॥

translations.english: "Sri Rama matches Vaidehi perfectly in character, age, behaviour, birth and auspicious signs. She is aware that he is the right person for her. Rama deserves Vaidehi and this blackeyed lady deserves him."
